title: Audio recording
playbackHint: Play saved chunks in order. Switching chunks may briefly buffer. Playback pauses at missing audio.
audioError: Audio is unavailable. Access may have changed, the connection failed, or the file is unavailable.
audioGap: No playable audio exists at this position.
scope: Record an in-person meeting or interview. Save audio first, then transcribe when available. AI notes are not yet connected to this recording page.

asr.title: Audio transcription
asr.scope: Transcribe saved audio with AI using transcription credits. A retry creates a new version and replaces displayed text only after completion.
asr.recoveryError: Unable to recover the local request. Check browser storage settings.
asr.uncertain: The request result is unknown. Check the previous request to reuse the same intent.
asr.cancelUnknown: Cancellation is not confirmed. Refresh the status or cancel again.
asr.conflict: The transcription has changed. Check its latest status before continuing.
asr.denied: Unable to access this transcription. The connection or your access may have changed.
asr.acceptIncomplete: I understand this audio is incomplete and only saved parts will be transcribed.
asr.unknownSpeaker: Single-microphone transcription does not identify speakers. Select a timestamp to check the original audio.
asr.noText: No displayable speech was recognized in this version.
asr.textError: Unable to load this transcript version.

leaveHint: Leaving this page interrupts recording. Return to recover saved chunks. Let participants know before recording.
unavailable: Local recording is unavailable. Close any other recording tab and use a browser supporting audio capture and local storage.
disabled: New recordings are unavailable. Existing recordings can still be ended and saved.
name: Recording name
interrupted: This recording was interrupted. Unsaved audio immediately before the interruption may be missing.
incomplete: This audio is incomplete due to missing delivery or interrupted capture.
operationFailed: The operation did not finish. Retry ending or resuming the recording. Saved local audio is retained.
microphoneFailed: Recording was interrupted. Check the microphone and local storage. Saved chunks are retained.
uploadFailed: Some audio has not uploaded and remains on this device. Retry when the connection is available.
partialHint: End this recording with missing chunks marked. Unuploaded chunks remain on this device for individual download and cannot be added to the sealed recording later.
localHint: These are only chunks without a confirmed save, not the full recording. Clearing browser data deletes local chunks.
